test_participants_progress_tracker
TestParticipantsProgressTracker
Coach logs in and switches the Class Name selector to DSME_Automation (replacing the no-longer-existing ADCES_DSME cohort), confirming the Participant Progress Tracker dashboard loads

Coach adds a participant via the only reachable Partner/Program/Cohort combination in Add Participant (DSME_Automation itself isn't selectable there), verifies the 'Participant created' toast, then reopens the form and saves blank to confirm required-field validation errors appear instead of a silent creation
Participants page's Status filter dropdown exposes all six statuses the original suite exercised (Pending, Nurture, Active, Enrolled, Archived, Disenroll) as selectable options
Enrolled test participant's row-level status dropdown only offers valid forward transitions (Disenroll/Complete), not the full status list, confirming its context-dependent behavior

Actions dropdown runs end to end: Exclude/Include in Report toggles correctly regardless of starting state, Request Form Survey opens and closes cleanly, Reset Password shows a real confirmation toast, Download Report produces a file, and View Class Planner navigates to that tab
Coach searches for the participant by email and then by first name (the search field matches a single name token, not a full 'First Last' string), verifying the same row surfaces both times

Coach activates a Class Planner session via Start Session — the only session-activation control reachable in this environment, since the original suite's per-unit Activate/IA-Form/clinical-assessment flow (proven elsewhere in this repo for a different, credential-gated account) never opens for this participant here — and records Sessions Completed for test8 to compare against

Coach ends the active session, confirming the 'Session stopped' toast, and verifies Sessions Completed stays unchanged from test7's baseline — Start/End Session is a live-coaching-session control, not a mechanism for completing an educational unit
Coach downloads the Annual Assessment report from the Participants page and verifies a file download is produced

Coach creates a one-time meeting via the coach appointments API — the Scheduler tab's week-view calendar never opens an appointment-creation dialog for click/double-click/drag-select in this environment — and verifies it's retrievable with the expected title, duration, and 'Scheduled' status
Coach creates a second, weekly-recurring meeting via the same appointments API workaround and verifies it's retrievable, distinct from test10's one-time meeting, and also 'Scheduled'

Participant's DSMES Units progress bar renders the full 20 educational-unit segments from their assigned plan, with completed units a valid subset of the total — live-verified this count tracks the assigned curriculum rather than the meetings created/cancelled in test10/test11/test13, so it's checked independently of them
Coach cancels the meetings created in test10/test11 via the appointments API and verifies each disappears from the list — a regression check on cancel_meeting that also cleans up after this run
Searching for a participant that doesn't exist shows the 'NO DATA..' empty state instead of an error or stale rows
Creating a participant with an already-used email is rejected: the Create User modal stays open with a validation error instead of silently creating a duplicate record

test_hub_direct_message
TestHubDirectMessageCARole
p1: CA logs in to the Hub and navigates to Messages — Expected: Messages view loads and the 'New' action is visible
p2: Messages home shows the empty-thread placeholder — Expected: 'Select a conversation from the list to view the thread.' is visible
p3: CA sends a Direct Message to a participant with an attachment — Expected: the message is delivered to the DM thread
p4: New DM — send a long paragraph message and validate it is delivered — Expected: the long message body is visible in the thread
p5: CA opens the New DM composer, fills it, and clicks Cancel — Expected: the composer closes and no message is sent
p6: Search participant by email — Expected: matching option visible, then cleared
p7: Search participant by first name — Expected: matching option visible, then cleared
p8: Search participant by last name — Expected: matching option visible, then cleared
p9: Search participant with invalid data — Expected: 'No results found.' shown, then cancel closes composer
p10: Home search participant by email — Expected: matching conversation visible, then cleared
p11: Home search participant by first name — Expected: matching conversation visible, then cleared
p12: Home search participant by last name — Expected: matching conversation visible, then cleared
p13: Home search participant with invalid data — Expected: 'No conversations matching' shown, then cleared
p14: New DM — upload a file >10MB — Expected: 'Upload failed. Please upload' error, then Cancel closes composer
p15: Open a new tab, launch the MUSC web app and log in as the participant (SP) — Expected: the participant portal loads
p16: Participant opens the Discussion menu and selects 'Talk to My Coach' — Expected: the coach chat widget opens
p17: Participant sends a message to the coach via the chat widget — Expected: the message is submitted
p18: Verify the coach received an email notification — Expected: an email to qa+muscca@habitnu.com arrived after the participant messaged the coach
p19: Close the participant tab and return to the Hub (CA) tab — Expected: the participant tab is closed
p20: Back on the Hub (CA) tab, refresh Messages and capture the unread-count text — Expected: the unread-count indicator text is recorded (before sending)
p21: Open the conversation with the participant — Expected: the qa+muscspo@habitnu.com chat thread opens
p22: Send a chat message to the participant in the open thread — Expected: the message is submitted
p23: Validate the sent message timestamp matches the current system time — Expected: a timestamp within ±2 minutes of now is visible
p24: Verify the participant received an email notification — Expected: an email to qa+muscspo@habitnu.com arrived after a coach DM
p25: Refresh Messages and capture the unread-count text again — Expected: the unread-count indicator text is recorded (after sending)
p26: Assert the unread-count text changed after sending — Expected: the before and after unread-count texts do NOT match
p27: New DM — select only a participant (no message) — Expected: the Send button is disabled; Cancel closes the composer
p28: New DM — type only a message (no participant) — Expected: the Send button is disabled; Cancel closes the composer
p29: New DM — select a participant and type a message — Expected: the Send button is enabled; Cancel closes the composer
p30: New DM — participant + message + attachment — Expected: the Send button is enabled; Cancel closes the composer
p31: New DM — attachment only (no message) — Expected: the Send button is disabled; Cancel closes the composer
p32: New DM — attach a file then remove it — Expected: the attachment is removed (no 'Remove' action remains)
p33: Second coach (qa+ca) logs in on a new tab and DMs the participant — Expected: the message is sent in the participant's thread
p34: Regular coach (qa+muscca) re-opens the participant thread — Expected: the 'Second Coach' button is visible
